selection_synth: minimize mean orientation error among visual candidates with mean PSNR >= native and boundary <= native + 0.25; otherwise native
selection_real: maximize mean validation PSNR among visual candidates with mean LPIPS <= native + 0.005, including native. Lock before testing.
confirmation: Average seeds within each physical scene. Paired bootstrap by scene (5000 resamples). Real fusion with the locked v1.3 release is a secondary factorial comparison.
